text.p: Southampton have signed Norwegian international striker Stig Johansen from Bodo-Glimt in a link-up with his international team mate Egil Ostenstad.
The English premier league club said on Wednesday that Johansen had signed and would be available for Saturday's opening match of the new season against Bolton.
No financial details were available although media reports have suggested a fee of 600,000 pounds ($974,000).
Southampton, who also have Norwegian defender Claus Lundekvam on their books, are also chasing his international midfield compatriot Petter Rudi and hope to sign him on Monday.
